'''Marska''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who had been ordered by the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] to keep an eye on [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] [[Dixton]] while posing as his vacuous mistress. She was fanatically loyal to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and was far more capable and ruthless than her outward persona let on.<ref name="Godking-CC">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Classic Campaigns}}</ref>
